title: Not As Alone As It Feels
description: A weary figure sits alone under a single lamp at midnight while the house sleeps, then holds a phone glowing unanswered in a dark room, and finally rises into warm gold light with hands lifted - the question every tired heart asks, answered by Isaiah 40:29: He giveth power to the faint.

title: He Shall Doubtless Come Again
description: A sower crosses a dusk field in tears, scattering seed he can't afford to lose; a single seed glows in the dark earth as dawn begins; and the same field returns at golden sunrise, the sower standing amid bundled sheaves with arms raised in joy.

title: They That Be With Us Are More
description: A three-scene illustrated short film on 2 Kings 6:15-17: a servant frozen with fear at a mist-grey dawn wall as an army surrounds the city, Elisha kneeling in prayer as a single shaft of gold breaks the grey, and the same hillside revealed ablaze with horses and chariots of fire as the servant finally sees what surrounded him all along.

title: I Cannot Come Down
description: A three-scene illustrated short film on Nehemiah 6:2-4: a lone figure working a torchlit stone wall at night while amber light glows beyond it, a sealed scroll resting on a flat hazy plain with a small distant figure beckoning from far off, and dawn breaking gold over the same figure standing firm atop the finished wall with arms raised.

title: Nevertheless at Thy Word
description: A three-scene illustrated short film on Luke 5: a weary fisherman slumped over an empty net at grey dawn, a boat pushed out into brightening teal water as Jesus says launch into the deep, and a gold sunrise catch so large the net begins to tear and the boats begin to sink under it.

title: But God Meant It Unto Good
description: A three-scene illustrated short film on Genesis 50: brothers lowering Joseph into a dusty cistern at dusk, a single figure forgotten in a cold barred cell as the years pass, and two silhouettes folded into one another in warm rose-gold morning light as the brothers who betrayed him are wept over and forgiven.

title: When the Thorn Stays
description: A three-scene illustrated short film on 2 Corinthians 12: a kneeling figure praying beside a wine-dusk thorn bramble that won't move, a single crack of gold light breaking through near-black as the weakness is named honestly, and warm dawn light pouring out over that same thorn as the figure stands with arms raised - grace poured out around what never left.

title: These Bones Shall Live
description: A three-scene illustrated short film visualizing Ezekiel 37's valley of dry bones: sun-bleached bones scattered across an ash-grey valley floor, a lone prophet lifting his hands as teal breath breaks through the grey, and the bones standing up as a great army under a gold-blue dawn.

title: Throw It Down
description: A four-scene illustrated short film: a lone shepherd and his staff in the wilderness at dusk, the staff thrown to the ground and transforming into a serpent in a tense dark grove, a hand reaching back to grip the serpent as it turns back into a rod in breaking gold light, and the shepherd standing tall holding the rod aloft under a triumphant blue-gold dawn. A visual telling of Exodus 4:2-4 - the ordinary thing in your hand, surrendered and renamed by God.

title: Trade Your Yoke
description: A four-scene illustrated short film: a weary traveler bowed under an unseen weight on a dusk road, hands exchanging a worn yoke for a new one in firelit gold, a figure standing upright as cool night breaks into gold dawn with the old burden left behind, and a quiet green pastoral sunrise where a flock finally rests. A visual telling of Matthew 11:28-30 - trading the yoke that's crushing you for the one that was made to fit.

title: Pursue, Overtake, Recover All
description: A burned-out camp smolders into night as a grieving man kneels under a single shaft of light to ask God one question, then runs hard across a torch-lit dusk wilderness after what was taken - arriving at a gold sunrise where the flock is walked back in and nothing is missing. A visual telling of David at Ziklag (1 Samuel 30): ash, inquiry, pursuit, and a dawn where nothing is lacking.

title: If I May But Touch
description: A sun-baked crowd presses in around a solitary figure at midday; close in warm firelight as a trembling hand reaches for the hem of a robe; then a wide gold dawn burst as the woman stands healed, arms lifted to the light - a short illustrated film on Mark 5:27-29, on reaching for Jesus on purpose instead of brushing past Him by accident.

title: The Word, Faith, and Prayer
description: Our founding teaching, on video — the heart behind everything Word and Faith Network does, spoken plainly, person to person.

title: Lay the Debt Down
description: A single thread wound tight, a quiet room, a slow breath releasing. Restrained, muted-grade motion graphics built around one image: forgiveness as finally letting go of what you'd been gripping — without reopening the door.

title: Lay the Debt Down (Morning Light)
description: The same prayer, retold in warm paper-and-cream tones instead of near-black — the coiled thread finally unwinding into a loose, easy ribbon. Release told gently rather than heavy.

title: Steady, Even When the Day Isn't
description: Four small pictures of one truth: a sunrise, a long road with its waypoints, a seed just breaking ground, an anchor resting beneath slow water. Faith that holds even when feeling doesn't.

title: Approved, Not Ashamed & Planted by the Rivers
description: A sermon-summary reflection drawing together two teachings from this week — studying for an audience of One (2 Timothy 2:15) and the tree planted by the rivers of water (Psalm 1:1-3) — told through a quiet study, a planted seed, a steady anchor, and a slow dawn.

title: An Audience of One
description: A hand finally loosening its grip on something it was holding too tight, giving way to a seed breaking quiet ground, and settling into the stillness of an anchor at rest — a visual journey from straining for applause to resting in God's approval alone.

title: Preach to Your Own Soul
description: A six-chapter illustrated short film: a prophet among dead vines at dusk, a man on an ash heap in grey ruins, a king awake on a moonlit Jerusalem rooftop, three men on three peaks at dawn, a modern man at a rain-streaked window, and a hind on the high places at sunrise. Three ruins, one decision - rejoicing was never a reaction; the will moves first.

title: Peace, Be Still
description: A storm-tossed boat at night under lightning and rain, calmed when a figure stands as black clouds split by gold light, resting at last into a rose-gold sunrise at sea - the story of Mark 4:35-41, and what it means to trust the same voice that's still in the boat with you before the waves actually stop.

title: What Holds You
description: A lone traveler drags a boulder across a dusk canyon, kneels exhausted beneath a vast starlit sky, and watches the stone crack open into gold light as dawn breaks and the weight finally lifts - a short visual parable of Psalm 55:22 and Colossians 1:17, on handing the thing you've been secretly dragging to the One who already holds everything together.
